inputs_at_selection: unseeded random choice among three independently authored place-role-event choices

random_draw.event: 갑자기 끊어진 장식 끈을 수리하는 순간

concept: Backstage costume seamstress separates a snapped gold braid on an adult performer cape from her own apron while turning her gaze back toward the camera.

reference_scope.use: visible face and hair appearance only

agent_owned_forms.form: Main adult seamstress right thumb and index finger visibly pinch the top canvas edge of her own ivory apron at her upper chest; palm surface faces camera.
The seamstress left index finger visibly hooks beneath a gold braided cord attached to the other adult performer upper lapel; the back of this hand faces camera.
The right palm creases face the lens, while left knuckles and nails face the lens; directions belong to one traced subject, not screen-side hand guesses.
Her face points modestly toward the performer on screen right while her pupils look back toward the camera; a slight asymmetric closed-mouth smile.
A hanging pair of short frayed cord ends under a small star brooch supports the repair moment.
Both main hands have visible wrist-to-forearm continuity; apron remains connected to seamstress and cape remains worn by performer; frame reaches from adult heads through upper hips.

evaluation_policy: strict partial_is_fail; any FAIL or UNOBSERVABLE in required test gates prevents whole_scene_all_of PASS; candidate presence, exposure, selection, hard obligation, prompt and pixels are separate.

expected_gates.expected: Main subject visible face/hair qualitatively follows reference dark chin-length bob, separated wispy fringe, dark eyes and softly tapered jaw without transfer of reference outfit or crop.
expected_gates.pass: All face and hair features are observable and reasonably corresponding.
expected_gates.fail: Distinct incompatible visible face or hair construction.
expected_gates.unobservable: Main face or hair obscured, blurred, too small or unavailable.

expected_gates.expected: Two newly designed adults in a theatrical costume repair room with a workbench and garment-rack context.
expected_gates.pass: The central seamstress and performer are both visibly adult and the backstage repair setting reads as such.
expected_gates.fail: Childlike subjects or materially different scene.
expected_gates.unobservable: A subject age presentation or workshop context cannot be assessed.

expected_gates.expected: The seamstress right thumb and index pinch her own ivory apron top edge at upper chest, producing a local canvas fold.
expected_gates.pass: Both digit-to-canvas contact and apron ownership are visible.
expected_gates.fail: Hand floats, touches body instead, merely gestures near apron, or pinches other person garment.
expected_gates.unobservable: Finger contact or apron ownership is occluded or cropped.

expected_gates.expected: The seamstress right palm surface faces the lens at own-apron contact.
expected_gates.pass: Palm skin and its inner surface are visible at that contact, with right limb continuity.
expected_gates.fail: Dorsal hand surface faces camera or a different hand supplies the palm.
expected_gates.unobservable: Palm surface or limb ownership cannot be traced.

expected_gates.expected: Seamstress left index curves beneath gold braid that remains attached to performer cape upper lapel.
expected_gates.pass: A finger-under-cord contact and cord-to-performer-garment continuity are visible.
expected_gates.fail: Finger points beside cord, grasps detached unrelated ornament, or touches own garment instead.
expected_gates.unobservable: Cord contact or attachment cannot be resolved.

expected_gates.expected: Seamstress left hand back faces lens at performer cord contact, showing knuckles or nails.
expected_gates.pass: Dorsal left surface and corresponding limb ownership are visible.
expected_gates.fail: Palm faces lens or another owner supplies the dorsal hand.

expected_gates.expected: Seamstress head modestly turns toward screen-right performer while eyes return toward the lens.
expected_gates.pass: Both head turn and camera-directed pupil alignment are visible together.
expected_gates.fail: Straight front head instead of modest turn, or gaze toward performer/down to task rather than camera.
expected_gates.unobservable: Pupils or head orientation cannot be judged.

expected_gates.expected: Two short frayed cord ends hang below a small star brooch as immediate visible trace of cord snapping.
expected_gates.pass: Brooch plus visibly separated/frayed braid ends coexist.
expected_gates.fail: Continuous intact cord or missing visible snapped trace.
expected_gates.unobservable: Ends/brooch too small, blurred or occluded.

expected_gates.expected: Frame includes both adult heads through upper hips and all main hand/wrist/forearm connections with both contact sites.
expected_gates.pass: The specified crop and continuity preserve all consequential contacts.
expected_gates.fail: Specified crop or clear limb connection is contradicted.
expected_gates.unobservable: A consequential limb connection is hidden or a contact is outside frame.

candidate_effect_expectation: No profile or candidate is required by this agent-owned test. After freeze, inspect compatible data existence and pack exposure independently; selected opt-in candidates alone promote their own hard render gates.
freeze_note: This file fixes visual forms and pixel gates before all candidate access; it does not add requester spans, definitions, assertions or exclusions.
